definition: having, consisting or composed of, letters (written or spoken).

definition: expressing sympathy with another in grief; condoling.
example_en: He wrote a letter expressing condolence.

definition: the correct manner of speaking that is generally accepted in the society.
example_en: One must follow correct manner of speech while speaking in an assembly.

definition: an auspicious, lucky woman.
example: ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಭದ್ರೆಯೆಂದು ಹೆಸರಾದ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: At the wedding everyone blessed her, who was known as an auspicious woman.

definition: a large drum.
example_en: They beat the large drum loudly during the festival.

definition: a variety in sword-fighting.
example_en: The teacher taught a new variety of sword-fighting technique.

definition: to shout, scream very loudly in fright or pain.
example_en: The boy screamed loudly in fright.

definition: the lime tree Citrus aurantium (var. berganeio) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: They have planted lime trees in the garden.

definition: the small-sized, evergreen tree Murraya koenigii of Rutaceae family, with fragrant leaves, used in seasoning food.
example_en: A curry-leaf tree has grown in the kitchen backyard.

definition: chewed betel leaves.
example_en: The grandmother spat the chewed betel leaves onto the veranda.

definition: to let (a liuqid) fall in drps.
example_en: The rain first fell in small drops.

definition: the captain of a unit of soldiers.
example_en: The captain led the soldiers into battle.

definition: the strict and sincere following of or adherence to religious and pious practices and keeping from religious defilement.
example_en: Her strict adherence to pious practices was renowned throughout the village.

definition: a long and formal treatment of a subject, in speech or writing; a discourse.
example_en: The teacher gave a discourse on the Bhagavad Gita.

definition: a testing of currency notes or coins, gems, pearls to determine their genuinenes, worth, etc.; shroffing.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ನಾಣ್ಯಗಳ ಪಾರಕಾವಣೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper shroffed the coins to check their genuineness.

definition: the act of sleeping.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಪನ ಬೇಕಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the long journey, he needed sleep.

definition: to take in to one's hand; to receive; to accept.
example_en: He took the letter in his hand and read it.

definition: sometimes; occasionally; not regularly.
example_en: Sometimes the mind grows weary.

definition: barely or moderately warm; lukewarm.
example_en: He bathed in lukewarm water.

definition: she who is gracious, benevolent.
example_en: The devotees worshipped the benevolent goddess with devotion.

definition: any of a large order (Coleoptera) of insects, including weevils, with biting mouthparts; a beetle.
example_en: Weevil beetles were found in the sack of paddy.

definition: the act of kindling, causing, fire burn with flame.
example: ಒಣಗಿದ ಹುಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಪಟೂಕರಣ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They set fire to the dry grass and kindled it into a blaze.

definition: turned or spun around a centre or axis; revolved.
example_en: The wheel revolved rotating around its axis.

definition: difficulty or distress; vexation, affliction; trouble.
example_en: The child's illness became a great trouble for them.

definition: a man of black complexion.
example_en: That black-complexioned man is known to everyone in the village.

definition: the act or an instance of pulling (something or each other) in opposite directions.
example_en: A tug-of-war took place between the two.

definition: a man who herds and takes care of sheep; a shepherd.
example_en: That shepherd took the sheep to the hill.

definition: the eye which cannot see the objects clearly; a blurry-eye.
example: ಮಬ್ಬುಗಣ್ಣಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ದೂರದ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: With his blurry eyes he could not see the distant hills clearly.

definition: the utterance in the presence of another person of a false statement or statements, damaging to a third person's character or reputation; slandering.
example_en: Nobody gives respect to those who slander.

definition: the moon, when it appears to have one concave edge and one convex edge.
example_en: The crescent moon with one concave and one convex edge looked beautiful in the sky.

definition: to make a pair (by joining two matching things).
example_en: She picked two matching bangles and made them a pair.

definition: a raised land; an extent of land higher than pieces of land adjacent to it.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಮಿಂಟೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A raised mound stood out in the middle of the village.

definition: the act of accusing; accusation.
example_en: The accusation against that person was recorded in the court.

definition: the headquarter of a district having about five hundred villages or small towns.
example: ಆ ಡಂಬ ಐನೂರು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳ ಆಡಳಿತ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That headquarters was the administrative centre of five hundred villages.

definition: a variety of screw pine tree.
example_en: There are screw pine plants on the bank of that lake.

definition: a post, on the roadside, esp. at cross roads, carrying a board giving direction for different destinations; a hand-post.
example_en: At the crossroads, the hand-post was showing the names of the villages.

definition: the tree Cinnamomum tamala of Lauraceae family.
example_en: Wild cinnamon trees had grown in the forest.

definition: one's eldest son.
example_en: The eldest son takes care of all the household duties.

definition: a man who acts on his own disregarding accepted rules and standards.
example: ಆ ಉಡಾಳ ಹುಡುಗ ಯಾರ ಮಾತನ್ನೂ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That reckless boy would not listen to anyone.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example: ಆ ವರ್ಷ ಮಳೆ ಬುಲ್ಲಯಿಸಿ ಕೆರೆಗಳು ತುಂಬಿದವು.
example_en: That year the rain became abundant and the ponds filled up.

definition: to give or provide a place or room.
example_en: The hosts gave place to the guests.

definition: to move in the air above (something); to fly over.
example_en: The eagle flew, moving above the hill.

definition: a male monarch of a major territorial unit, esp. one whose position is hereditary and who rules for life; a king.
example_en: The king of that city was popular among the people.

definition: an animal used for pulling heavy loads; a draft animal.
example_en: The ox is a draft animal.

definition: the apparent canopy over our heads; the firmament.
example_en: The birds flew freely across the firmament.

definition: the setting sun.
example_en: The setting sun disappeared behind the hill.

definition: a speech that is sounding sweet and smooth.
example_en: Her sweet, honeyed speech captivated everyone's heart.

definition: to accuse; to charge; to allege.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಆ ಯುವಕನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಳ್ಳತನದ ಅಗಡುಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The police accused that young man of theft.

definition: that which is white.
example_en: The whiteness of this cloth is very pure.

definition: to cause to tie, fasten or intertwine in or with a knot or knots.
example_en: Mother had her son tie the rope with a knot.

definition: a god; a deity.
example_en: By the grace of the god, rain came.

definition: physical work; hard-work; laborious work.
example_en: Working in the field is laborious work.

definition: the quality of being creative; creative ability.
example_en: That artist's creative ability amazed everyone.

definition: to enter on to a stage for presenting a play, dance, etc.
example_en: The actor entered the stage and captivated the audience.

definition: an office worker who keeps records, types letters, does filing, etc. ; a clerk.
example: ಆ ಕ್ಲಾರ್ಕು ಕಚೇರಿಯ ಕಡತಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಪಾನವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That clerk carefully maintains the office's files.

definition: a small village.
example_en: The population of that small village is very low.

definition: a variety of Indian abutilon plant of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The large Indian abutilon plant grows beside the village.

definition: the inner side or space of a conch.
example_en: A little water remained inside the conch.

definition: the act, work of catching fish.
example_en: Going fishing during the rainy season is difficult.

definition: an extraordinary promise.
example_en: The teacher gave the disciple an extraordinary promise.

definition: to inlay - a) to set (pieces of wood, metal, etc.) into a surface to make a design that is usu. level with the surface; b) to decorate with such pieces.
example_en: That sculptor inlaid a flower on the pillar.

definition: to look at; to see; to stare at.
example_en: He stared intently at the sky.

definition: a piece of land that is owned by more than one person jointly.
example_en: They jointly cultivate the jointly owned land.

definition: to be separated lengthwise into two or more parts; to be split.
example_en: That piece of wood split apart in the sun.

definition: in, at or near the centre.
example: ಮನೆಯ ನಡುವಣ ಕೋಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವರ ಪೂಜೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a puja room in the central room of the house.

definition: a conjunctional suffix, affixed to the end of each word to be connected in a sentence.
example_en: Rama and Sita and Lakshmana went to the forest.

definition: the science and practice of medicine for horses.
example: ಅಶ್ವವೈದ್ಯನು ಕುದುರೆಯ ಕಾಲಿನ ಗಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಔಷಧ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: The horse doctor applied medicine to the wound on the horse's leg.

definition: the act of substituting a word for another.
example_en: The translator clarified the sentence by substituting a word.

definition: a man who makes his living on astrology; an astrologer.
example_en: The astrologer looked at the horoscope and predicted the future.

definition: Śaci, Indra's wife.
example: ಇಂದ್ರವಧು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ಪತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Purana says that Indra's wife lives in heaven with her husband.

definition: that which is strung together, arranged or set forth in a row.
example_en: The figures in the book have been arranged in a row.

definition: a building or hall in for dance presentation; a dance theatre or hall.
example_en: A Bharatanatyam performance took place in the dance hall.

definition: lively interest; enthusiasm; zeal.
example: ಹೊಸ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಅವಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ಹುರುಪು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: She had a lot of enthusiasm for the new job.

definition: a man who digs (the earth); an excavator.
example_en: That excavator dug the earth for a well.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example: ಡೆಂಕಣವು ಭಾರವಾದ ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ದೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಎಸೆಯಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The projectile helped hurl a heavy stone to a distance.

definition: a very timid, cowardly man.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಬೇಡಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆದರಿ ಓಡಿಹೋದನು.
example_en: That timid coward ran away frightened even by a small sound.

definition: a bund, embankment that prevents water from flowing.
example_en: The bund stopped and held back the water.

definition: an earthen vessel.
example_en: She came filling the earthen vessel with water.

definition: holy; sacred; venerable.
example: ಈ ತಿರು ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿವರ್ಷ ಭಕ್ತರು ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Devotees come to this holy place every year.

definition: a formal way to move on; a path, road; a furrow made by vehicles.
example: ಗಾಡಿ ಹೋದ ಅಂಚೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಣ್ಣು ಗುರುತಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The furrow left by the vehicle remained marked in the mud.

definition: an annoying or being annoyed; annoyance; infliction.
example: ಪಕ್ಕದ ಮನೆಯವರ ಶಬ್ದ ನನಗೆ ಉಪದ್ರವ ಎನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The neighbor's noise felt like an annoyance to me.

definition: the bean plant Dolichos lablab (var. typicum) of Papilionaceae family; flat bean.
example_en: She added flat beans to the curry.

definition: to annoy - a) to cause to feel irritated, displeased or angry; b) to tease, to molest, to trouble, to put to inconvenience by repeated or continued acts.
example: ಮಗು ನಿದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಅವನು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಕಟ್ಟಬಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: While the child was sleeping, he kept annoying it again and again.

definition: to feel shame; to be distressed or embarrassed by feelings of guilt, foolishness or disgrace; to be ashamed.
example_en: He felt ashamed for having made a mistake.

definition: a man having skill in using one's hands; a very manipulative man.
example: ಆ ಕೈಚಳಕಿಗ ಮುರಿದ ಗಡಿಯಾರವನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That manipulative craftsman easily repaired the broken clock.

definition: a legal case in a court of law.
example_en: That legal case is still going on in the court.

definition: a girl or woman who is studying under the guidanceof a teacher; a female pupil.
example_en: The female pupil was learning her lesson from the teacher.

definition: an optical illusion, in which a water-body is seen, caused by the refraction of light in the hot air; a mirage.
example_en: In summer, a mirage is seen on the road.

definition: an income, earnings; revenue.
example: ಆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಅಡಹಿಕೆ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹಳ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The income from that land was substantial per year.

definition: an interjection used to point out an object which is relatively near.
example_en: Look, the moon is in the sky.

definition: one who does not regard the social, legal or moral rules of conduct; a trespasser; a transgressor.
example_en: The police arrested the transgressor of the law.

definition: a thick forest.
example_en: The travelers lost their way in that thick forest.

definition: inaccessible - a) impossible to reach or enter; b) that cannot be seen, talked to, influenced, etc.; inapproachable.
example: ಆ ಗುಹೆ ಬಹಳ ಗಹ್ವರವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಯಾರೂ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಲಾರರು.
example_en: That cave is so inaccessible that no one can enter it.

definition: a land gifted as an endowment to a person, as a mark of recognition, which is exempt from paying tax.
example_en: There was no tax on that gifted endowment land.

definition: an abnormal drowsiness or sleep.
example: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನದ ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮೈಕ ಬಂದು ಕುರ್ಚಿಯಲ್ಲೇ ನಿದ್ದೆಹೋದನು.
example_en: After the afternoon meal, drowsiness came over him and he fell asleep right in the chair.

definition: a man who adheres to a system of moralism; a moralist.
example_en: The town's moralist condemned this injustice.

definition: a gift or contribution, as to a charitable organisation.
example_en: He gave some contribution to the orphanage.

definition: to come forth; to be emitted from within; to come or go out.
example_en: Clean water came forth from the spring.

definition: a covering closely muffled.
example_en: He wrapped himself in a thick covering to protect from the cold.

definition: a finger that is shorter than normal one or permanently distorted.
example_en: There was a stunted finger on her right hand.

definition: a man dwelling in, residing at (someplace).
example_en: He said that he was a resident of Bengaluru.

definition: a good tempered, sympathetic, benevolent woman.
example_en: Being a kind-hearted woman, she helped everyone.

definition: an educational institution which lays down the plans for higher education and which governs certain number of colleges; a university.
example_en: He is studying science at the university.

definition: that portion of a pair of tongs, which holds an object.
example_en: Because the holding part of the tongs broke, the tongs became useless.

definition: the royal court-hall.
example_en: The king heard the people's grievances in the royal court-hall.

definition: the deciduous tree Tectona grandis of Verbenaceae family with white flowers and hard, yellowish brown wood used for shipbuilding, furniture, etc,; teak.
example: ಆ ಹಡಗನ್ನು ಹಾಡಗ ಮರದ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: That ship was built with teak wood.

definition: (masc.) one who invites.
example: ಸಭೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಕರೆದ ಆಮಂತ್ರಕ ಬಾಗಿಲಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The host who invited everyone to the gathering stood at the door.

definition: an internal parasite; endoparasite.
example_en: The tapeworm is an internal parasite (endoparasite).

definition: the latent heat in the wood; the burning quality of the wood.
example_en: The burning quality of the dry wood made it catch fire quickly.

definition: a beloved person.
example_en: He was the beloved of her heart.

definition: a scissors-like mouse-trap.
example_en: They have set a mouse-trap in the kitchen.

definition: a daring enterprise or undertaking; a great adventure.
example_en: That mountain climb was a great adventure.

definition: to be separated lengthwise into two or more parts; to be split.
example_en: The bamboo split apart in the wind.

definition: a man who or that which distroys or has the tendence to destroy; a destroyer.
example: ಆ ವಿಧ್ವಂಸಕ ಇಡೀ ಪಟ್ಟಣವನ್ನು ನಾಶ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That destroyer destroyed the entire town.

definition: a place where wild animals are kept for public showing; a zoo; a zoo-garden.
example_en: The children went to the zoo during the holidays.

definition: the extent of a subject being thought of or pondered about.
example_en: The extent of the subject pondered in this book is very vast.

definition: the act of attracting or condition of being attracted; attraction.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಸೆಳಕು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a strange attraction in that painting.

definition: a stack of hay.
example_en: They gathered a stack of hay for the cattle.

definition: to make weak or weaker; to weaken; to render powerless, courageless.
example_en: The news of the defeat weakened the soldiers.

definition: to become greater in size, amount, degree etc.; to grow; to increase.
example_en: The price of water increases in summer.

definition: to fill the pouch made by a woman (whose husband is alive) with rice, coconut etc. with blessings or good wishes.
example_en: The ceremony of filling the pouch of the married woman took place.

definition: any of vices considered to be the enemies in one's spiritual life (as lust, anger, avarice, delusion, conceit, jealousy, etc.).
example_en: One must conquer inner enemies like anger and desire.

definition: the lotus plant.
example_en: The lotus plant had spread all over the pond.

definition: a desiring or a desire for something.
example_en: He had a desire to go abroad.

definition: undecaying; imperishable; not degenerating; eternal.
example_en: The scriptures say that the soul is imperishable.

definition: to hang by attaching to something above; to suspend.
example_en: He hung the lamp by attaching it to the hook above.

definition: a man of such and such an age.
example_en: That man of such age was the village elder.

definition: to come nearer; to approach.
example_en: The child approached its mother.

definition: a heavy thing.
example_en: This is a heavy thing, hard to lift.

definition: curly hair.
example_en: Everyone liked that girl's curly hair.

definition: the branch of medicine dealing with the prevention and treatment of diseases and injuries in cattle; veterinary science.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಗೋವೈದ್ಯ ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೊಳಗಾದ ಎತ್ತನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The veterinary doctor of that village examined the sick bullock.

definition: a shrunken neck.
example: ಬಳಲಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಆ ಮುದುಕನ ಗುಜ್ಜುಗೊರಲ್ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಕುಗ್ಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: From exhaustion, that old man's shrunken neck had shrunk even further.

definition: a person whose profession is grazing cattle.
example_en: The cowherd took the cattle towards the field.

definition: a violent stream; a flood of water.
example_en: A violent flood of water came and submerged the whole valley.

definition: to clothe, adorn or put on.
example: ಆಕೆ ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಹೊಸ ಸೀರೆಯನ್ನು ತಳ್ದಳು.
example_en: She put on a new sari on the festival day.

definition: the fact or condition of being separated or removed in space; distance.
example: ಎರಡು ಊರುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ವಿದೂರ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was considerable distance between the two towns.

definition: to provide a banquet.
example_en: The king provided a banquet for the guests.

definition: a measurable distance between two points or things.
example_en: That distance must be measured and known.

definition: a man who creates agitation, disorder in a community or society.
example_en: That agitator caused a disturbance in the village.

definition: freedom from disease; soundness; health.
example_en: Good health is possible through eating clean food.

definition: a seasonal wind of the Indian Ocean, blowing from the southwest from April to October; monsoon.
example_en: As the monsoon wind blew, the rainy season began.

definition: any of a large family (Culicidae) of two-winged dipteran insects, the females of which have skin-piercing mouthparts used to extract blood from animals, including humans; a mosquito.
example: ದೋಮ ಕಡಿದರೆ ಚರ್ಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುಳ್ಳೆ ಏಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If a mosquito bites, a bump rises on the skin.

definition: a word used to affirm or solemnify that the statement one has made is true.
example_en: What I said is true, I swear!

definition: a happening; occurrence; an occasion.
example_en: This occurrence happened accidentally.

definition: the fact or condition of not being attached to worldly things or not having selfish motives.
example: ಆ ಸಾಧುವಿನ ನೋಸಂಸಾರ ಬದುಕು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಮಾದರಿ.
example_en: That ascetic's detached, unworldly life is a model for everyone.

definition: to smear; to anoint.
example: ಗಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹೊರೆಯಿಡಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The doctor said oil must be smeared on the wound.

definition: to discharge the contents of; to empty.
example_en: He emptied out all the grain that was in the sack.

definition: (myst.) a diagram or an amulet worshipped for gaining or regaining good health.
example_en: Suffering from illness, she worshipped the health amulet.

definition: to cause to come forth or be emitted.
example_en: He drew out water from the well and filled the vessel.

definition: of every day; done, to be done, happening, published, every day; daily.
example_en: Worship is one of his daily duties.

definition: the duty and profession of a barber.
example_en: The barber's profession was the trade of his family.

definition: (one's patience) to be lost.
example_en: Having waited a long time, his patience was lost.

definition: (rural colloq.) from this time on; hereafter; henceforth.
example_en: From this time on, you must be careful.

definition: curly hair.
example_en: Her curly hair spread over her shoulders.

definition: a girl who has recently attained menstrual stage.
example_en: They got new clothes for the girl who had recently attained menstrual stage.

definition: (gem.) any plain figure bounded by four straight lines, making four angles inside, as a square, rectangle, quadrilateral, parallelogram, trapezium, etc.
example: ಅವನು ಚವಕ ಆಕಾರದ ಗಾಜಿನ ತುಂಡನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He cut a quadrilateral-shaped piece of glass.

definition: a sticky, colloidal carbohydrate found in certain trees and plants, which dissolves in water and used as or in making adhesive; a gum.
example: ಬೊಂಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು ಮರದ ತೊಗಟೆಗೆ ಗಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They cut the tree's bark to collect the gum.

definition: the western region of Tamil Nadu in South India; the present Coimbatore region.
example_en: The Konga region is famous for its weaving industry.

definition: anything that is remaining; remainder; balance.
example_en: After the expenses, he saved the remaining money.

definition: devoid of hearing and hence cannot enjoy the music, recital of poetry, etc.
example_en: Being devoid of hearing, he could not enjoy the sweetness of music.

definition: the four directions or sides (as north, south, east and west directions or left, right, front and back sides).
example_en: The sound of thunder was heard in all four directions.

definition: (hist.) an association of merchants.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಮರಿದಂಡ ದೂರದೂರುಗಳಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days the merchant caravan used to go to distant towns for trade.

definition: a rigid support, as a beam, stake or pole, placed under or against a structure or part; a prop.
example_en: They erected a post as a support to the wall.

definition: an acute, severe, infectious disease, caused by bacteria Vibrio cholerae, characterised by profuse diarrhoea, vomiting, dehydration, cramps, etc.; cholera.
example_en: Cholera broke out in the village and the people grew fearful.

definition: the sound of belching.
example_en: He belched loudly.

definition: the quality or fact of being formless; formlessness.
example_en: The formlessness of that void cannot be described in words.

definition: the act or process of wearing or being ornamented with, a ring or the like.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ಕೈಬೆರಳಿನ ಉಂಗ್ರುಡಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The wearing of the ring on her finger drew everyone's attention.

definition: to lose one's course.
example_en: The traveller walking in the dark lost his course.

definition: a variety of bird.
example_en: An araliga bird was perched in the garden.

definition: a salad made of soaked split green-gram or Bengal gram seasoned with oil, salt, lime, etc.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಕುಸುಂಬರಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಂಚಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother made kusumbari salad for the festival and shared it with everyone.

definition: a big building.
example: ಆ ಇಮಾರತು ನಗರದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎತ್ತರವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: That big building stands tall in the middle of the city.

definition: to reduce; to bring down the level of.
example_en: The government decided to reduce the level of the tax.

definition: to cause to eat; to feed.
example_en: The mother fed rice to the child.

definition: formal consent; leave; license; permission.
example_en: He did not get leave to go to school.

definition: to hit with the hand or a tool, weapon, etc. with an intention to hurt; to strike.
example_en: The people struck that thief with a stick.
